text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: decode-gpu OOM spike on eu-decode-prod-2 (pod decode-7f9b). Symptoms: CUDA OOM during streaming decode -> elevated 5xx/drop rate. Affected route: /v1/stream/decoder. See runbook: https://redwood/in/incident/6212345678

sam: who is oncall for decoder right now?

keiko: i'm oncall, joining now. looking.

miguel: copying monitoring: 5m window: 46k reqs, drop rate 12% in eu region, p95 latency up 2s. I see repeated: `CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY` in decode logs. Also some clients sending huge `max_tokens` headers (looks like 50k+).

miguel: logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-17T16:12:03Z] decode-7f9b ERROR CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY at decode_loop.cpp:412
[2026-03-17T16:12:03Z] request_id=cr_9a2 max_tokens=120000 policy=streaming
[2026-03-17T16:12:04Z] evicting session kvcache to free memory
```

eli: immediate mitigations: 1) enforce token ceiling at edge for eu 2) route heavy streaming to fallback model 3) restart the pod if mem not reclaimed.

sam: can we push an emergency route that pins requests with large token budgets to small-decoder?

eli: yes. command: `routeset apply --match region=eu --expr "request.headers.max_tokens > 5000" --fallback small-decoder --ttl 10m`

sam: running now...
```
$ routeset apply --match region=eu --expr "request.headers.max_tokens > 5000" --fallback small-decoder --ttl 10m
applied route policy: eu-high-tokens -> small-decoder (duration 10m)
```

keiko: good. i'll evict pod and restart decode-7f9b. leaving oncall page for restart.

sam: executing drain/restart:
```
$ kubectl -n decode-prod delete pod decode-7f9b
pod "decode-7f9b" deleted
$ kubectl -n decode-prod get pods -w
decode-7f9b   0/1   Init:0/1   0   10s
decode-7f9b   1/1   Running   0   45s
```

miguel: restart_count went 0 -> 1. memory RSS stabilized. drop rate down to ~1.3% in last 2m. throughput recovering.

support-bot: Noted: 7 new CS tickets referencing timeouts/dropped streams in EU. CS triage in progress.

priya: drafting customer note: "We experienced transient request drops for streaming in EU due to a GPU memory surge triggered by unusually large generation budgets. We mitigated by routing oversized requests to a fallback model and restarting the affected node. If you saw failures, please retry; engineers are investigating to prevent recurrence." will post after review.

keiko: assign eng-sre for RCA — suspected cause: client misconfig (missing token caps) + insufficient router guardrails.

eli: agree. followups: add header enforcement at edge, tighter per-customer token budgeting, and improved telemetry on per-request token_ceiling.

sam: opening incident doc and linking to support ticket thread. I'll post a short internal summary in 10m.

incident-bot: Incident escalated: ENG-SRE page created -> https://redwood/in/incidents/6212345678/eng-sre. Pager cleared (status: contained).

keiko: monitoring for 20m, will handoff to daytime oncall after stabilization.

support-bot: customer updates queued. CS will send targeted messages to impacted accounts.

priya: posted customer note to status page and notified account owners.

sam: thanks all. follow-ups: RCA, telemetry gaps, and route guard implementation tasks. prepping postmortem template. :thumbsup:
